title: BPW-2026-0625
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0625
AFE – CALIFORNIA PRODUCT STEWARDSHIP COUNCIL (CPSC)
Bureau of Sanitation (BOS) and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $100,000 for encumbrance of funds to pay the CPSC to work with BOS’s Recycling Market Development Zone (RMDZ) team to identify several manufacturing businesses that could use funding to engage in sample runs of recycled feedstock and circular manufacturing processes, review and allocate funds to the appropriate candidate businesses, and other activities that promote the RMDZ zone, including industry outreach and updating zone marketing materials for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.
(AE27556591M, Fund 556 - Integrated Solid Waste Management Trust Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50WMMR)
summary: Approves a $100,000 payment to the California Product Stewardship Council to help the Bureau of Sanitation's Recycling Market Development Zone recruit manufacturers that could use recycled feedstock, for July 2026 through June 2027.
